0022600031.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, 10th in the West) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (6-3, 7th in the West) in the Pelicans' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with New Orleans riding a four-game winning streak. Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out for the Pelicans, while Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise) are out for Minnesota. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost the series 1-3, most recently losing 132-126 in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
